sources.quality_notes: Abstract states earliest arrival early 17th through Ming Quanji and Kim Chi; 1430 official title and 1485 legal title predate universal nonexistence assertion, but do not disprove a distinct Ming Quanji version import in 17th. 1550 compilation and direct Luo/Chen transmission remain unproven by abstract. Full paper and original historical apparatus not reviewed.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Generic claim that any Ziwei Shu first reached Joseon only circa 1600 is incompatible with 1430 Sejong exam title and 1485 curricular tradition

2018 abstract's Chen Tuan to Luo Hongxian 1550 to Kim Chi stemma is unproven against edition-stratified physical evidence

1430 institution text and Eulhaeja remnant relationship via original target-page mechanics
Potential separate introduction of a specific Ming Quanji edition to Kim Chi-era Joseon
